component.name: Bloom
component.summary: Bloom is a private and native cycle tracker

description.p: Bloom is a private and native cycle tracker. It helps you understand your body's patterns by predicting upcoming periods and ovulation days without ever sending your data to the cloud.

ul.li: Predict upcoming periods and ovulation days using a rolling median of your last 6 cycles.
Log basal body temperature, cervical mucus, and ovulation test (OPK) results.
Keep track of physical symptoms and daily notes.
View personalised insights, including your average cycle length and regularity.
All data is stored locally on your device using SQLite. No accounts, no clouds, no tracking.

screenshot.caption: Track your cycle with the calendar
Log detailed symptoms and body signs
View and search your daily notes

ul.li: Add an empty state for notes tab.
You can now filter notes by date.
Clicking on a note now takes you to the calendar view and shows the day dialog.
You can now undo from the displayed toast, after editing a day.
Notifications can be configured to display at a time a user chooses.
Recorded ovulations (via OPK) are now displayed on the insights heatmap.
Added shortcuts and a shortcuts dialog.
